# AICommander 3.0 — GitHub Issue templates (English)

[Russian workflow](../GITHUB_WORKFLOW.md) · [English workflow](../GITHUB_WORKFLOW.en.md)

The GitHub Issue templates themselves are written in Russian; this document provides English descriptions and links.

## Bug report
**Title:** `[V3][BUG] `

State the defect, source branch and commit, OS/Python/browser, module, exact reproduction steps, expected and observed behavior, redacted logs and command exit codes. Reproduce only with test data and without production warehouse access.

## Feature request
**Title:** `[V3][FEATURE] `

Describe the user problem, owner/agent workflow, required inputs and outputs, constraints, links to existing implementation to avoid duplication, testable acceptance criteria, dependencies and whether independent work can proceed in parallel. Require Russian docs with an English link and real tests/CI.

## Codex task
**Title:** `[V3][CODEX] `

Specify a bounded goal, ordered tasks, parent Issue/PR, base `v3-foundation`, whether Zorin is required, parallel conflicts, proposed model and reasoning effort, allowed files/tools, prohibited production operations, actual tests, exit codes and owner approval. The model must report real results and its substitutions; never invent test success.
